description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for tasks, providing methods to query, insert, update, and delete task entities in a database, likely using Room persistence library in an Android project.

classes.name: TaskDao
classes.description: Data Access Object interface for performing database operations related to tasks.

methods.name: observeAll
methods.description: Returns a Flow that emits a list of all TaskEntity objects, ordered by completion status and update time.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a TaskEntity by its ID, returning null if no such task exists.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of tasks in the database.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a task into the database, replacing any existing one with the same primary key.

methods.name: insertAll
methods.description: Inserts a list of tasks into the database, replacing existing entries as needed.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing task in the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specific task from the database.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a task identified by its ID.
